finding_description: Preserving the possibility of cooperation while delaying irreversible investment is not adequately covered by the signaling explanation reviewed in this episode.
theoretical_justification: L-DEMO-01 addresses observable signals and interpretation but not waiting for a milestone before investment; this does not establish noncoverage by all literature.
empirical_justification: C001 records deferred equipment investment; C002 links orders to the testing milestone.
remaining_uncertainty: Adjacent explanations such as real options may cover it; they have not yet been checked

preliminary_relevance.why: Distinguishes information display from investment decisions
preliminary_relevance.degree: Bounded and provisional; coverage by adjacent theory reduces novelty

finding_description: Current materials do not establish whether the agreement changed the partner’s quality evaluation.
theoretical_justification: The signaling explanation requires audience interpretation; only the signatory’s account is available.
empirical_justification: C001/C002 do not record the partner’s own evaluation.
remaining_uncertainty: Evidence of audience interpretation is missing
